fixedFrame.coordinates: U/V is a fixed orthographic coordinate chart, not the local differential tangent frame. After local contour and gaze offsets, depth is ray-projected onto the actual curved body.
fixedFrame.anchorScope: L means negative-X eye in front view; R means positive-X eye. No asymmetry copied from source perspective.

eyeL.coordinateConvention: Blender X right, Y back, Z up. Front faces negativeY.

eyeR.coordinateConvention: Blender X right, Y back, Z up. Front faces negativeY.

mouth.coordinateConvention: Blender X right, Y back, Z up. Front faces negativeY.

scaffold.faceRegionNote: Limits describe facial geometry workspace only. They never authorize moving body vertices or neutral anchors. Camera view must not move anchor coordinates.

expression.controls: Upper and lower lid contours, rounded stroke centreline/width, mouth exterior/interior profile, optional explicitly approved cheek tint.
expression.invariants: Neutral anchors and rest geometry are exact approved05. Each expression may define an explicit bounded contour offset relative to those fixed anchors. No body, foot, ear or camera compensation.

gaze.input: Reserved gazeDirection, independent from expression intensity
gaze.status: Independent gaze is not implemented in current r6 or these basic-face batches. Both eyes and attached highlights remain Body-weighted and expression-driven.
gaze.invariant: Never reinterpret highlight position as pupil aim. Do not move the two eyes to random face positions.

proposedLocalWholeEyeOffset.units: 3D design units in fixed face U/V frame, not copiedV1 pixels
proposedLocalWholeEyeOffset.status: Proposed sampling envelope only. Not implemented, not validated or enabled.
proposedLocalWholeEyeOffset.application: Both eye shape and its attached highlight move together on the curved face surface; fixed anchor definitions and mouth remain unchanged. Closed-stroke eyes taper gaze to zero.
proposedLocalWholeEyeOffset.validationBeforeUse: Sample centre/axis/corner gaze directions with all approved open/half-lid expressions, front/twoquarters/side, same99px scale; check body clearance, eye spacing, visible range and occlusion. Reproject final local coordinates onto actualskin, not flat XY translation.

highlight.input: Lighting-relative reflection placement and aperture visibility
highlight.implementation: Current white spots are stylized reflection caps, not eyeball whites or pupils. They follow eye surface mapping and shrink/collapse with closing aperture.
highlight.invariant: No surviving white dot on a closed eye. No gaze intent inferred solely from moving this cap.

stageGate: Single-face static paths only; no direct cross-face interpolation, gaze or runtime enabled.

batch5WorkspaceRevision.hiddenStates: Strict zero-area coincident brow points only; no exemption for visible geometry
